environment: Standard Compose ocr-cuda container calling http://unlimited-ocr2:10000
method: Same Python process, previous installed adapter and updated source adapter, alternating three load() calls each.
contract_preserved: Readiness rejects paused, starting, unhealthy, and shutting-down server states.
Every load() checks model snapshot revision and pinned runtime version.
Every load() queries live scheduler state through /get_server_info.
cause: Pinned /health and /health_generate share a synthetic one-token generation handler with a one-second polling sleep. /ready reads readiness state without generating a token.
scope: Adapter load() overhead only; does not measure OCR model throughput or full HTTP time to first token.
